items.name: Release v5.20.1
items.body: # Release v5.20.1 Special surprise including the new model Beam from Reflection AI :partying_face: Beam is a token-efficient, frontier-scale model focused on coding and agentic use cases. It is built for teams that want to run a powerful model on their own hardware, infrastructure, or cloud, and customize it to their specific needs. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/beam) * Fix small bug in auto mappings (#49664) by @yonigozlan in [#49664](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/49664) ## Some real patch fixes We broke loading models on older torch versions :cry: should be fixed now. But here is the full list of fixes - Fix HunYuan-VL image assignment during batched generation (#49557) by @Arnav66692 - Fix DeepGEMM Mega MoE under expert parallelism(#49428) by @IlyasMoutawwakil - Fix from_pretrained on torch 2.7: require torch>=2.8 for distributed checkpointing (#49652) by @naveecode - Make DtensorShardOperation work on torch 2.6 and 2.7 (#49657) by @hazelxue **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/compare/v5.20.0...v5.20.1
